content: Internal Revenue Service, Investigation Division. This is Officer Elliot Hayes speaking. With whom do I have the pleasure of speaking regarding your federal tax file?
Uh, hi, this is Jamie. I got a message saying there was a problem with my taxes? I just graduated, so I'm not sure why.

Jamie, thank you. Let me verify your file. According to IRS records, your 2021 and 2022 tax returns triggered an audit due to significant discrepancies in reported income and deductions. Are you aware of any issues regarding your federal tax filings?
No, I just used the free tax website. I thought I did everything right. I don't even make that much money.

Unfortunately, our audit indicates unreported earnings and potential misapplication of deductions. This has resulted in a substantial outstanding tax liability, including penalties and interest. Jamie, failure to address this immediately may result in severe federal actions.
Wait, what do you mean by federal actions? I don't understand.

If this matter is not resolved within the hour, the IRS will issue a lien on your bank accounts, freeze your wages, and initiate criminal proceedings for tax evasion. Additionally, your driver's license and passport eligibility will be suspended.
No, please, I didn't do anything wrong! I don't want to get arrested or lose my bank account. What am I supposed to do?

Your total liability is $6,842.17, including all late fees and interest. To halt enforcement, you must settle this balance today. The IRS accepts immediate settlements through secure payment channels. Are you prepared to resolve this now?
I don't have that kind of money! I can barely pay my student loans. Isn't there something else I can do?

Jamie, this is a federal matter. Partial payments can be accepted initially to stop criminal referral. The IRS accepts payments via wire transfer, direct deposit, or IRS-approved prepaid gift cards. You must remain on this line until we confirm your settlement.
Gift cards? Why do I have to use gift cards? That sounds weird.

This is standard for urgent compliance cases under IRS code section 7201. The payment will be documented, and you'll receive an electronic receipt. Failure to comply will result in immediate arrest and seizure of your assets.
Okay, okay. What kind of gift cards do I need to get, and how much?
Purchase $2,000 in Apple or Target gift cards at the nearest store. Once you have them, read the codes on the back to me for verification. This will temporarily halt enforcement actions.
I have to leave my apartment? Should I take you with me on the call?
Yes, stay on the line at all times. If the call disconnects or you delay, enforcement will proceed automatically. I am monitoring your file in real time for compliance.
Okay, I'm getting my shoes on. Can you just promise I won't get arrested if I do this?

As long as you follow these instructions and provide payment, your arrest warrant and federal charges will be suspended. Failure to comply will result in your immediate detention and permanent record.
